title: Gothenburg Museum of Art

buildingCutout.basis: Historic gallery footprint fitted to the historic building line in the mapped complex.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Gothenburg City 0.5 metre terrain sampled at the bottom of the historic Götaplatsen terrace.

mapIdentity.scope: Fitted the original building within the named museum’s current outline. Native straight terrace returns locate the front. The building’s historic footprint and original large stair arrangement are supported by the museum’s published history.

note: Anders Wilhelm Karnell’s 1923 public-domain photograph shows the width of the terraced stone base, seven arches, medallions and shallow roof. The museum identifies the original materials as Gothenburg yellow brick and hewn natural stone.
